{{Quote|You're not still sore about my strafing your pressure dome on that asteroid&mdash;''"<br />"''Not at all. I deserved it for trying to get the better of you on those chak-root runs to Gaurick.|Han Solo and [[Big Bunji/Legends|Big Bunji]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>}}
'''Gaurick''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. It was controlled by a religious cult, with leaders known as ''[[mufti]]s'', with the cult being known as the ''Renouncers''.<ref name="TEA" />

[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were hired to deliver [[Chak-root/Legends|chak-root]] to workers on Gaurick; the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] were almost taken captive when some of the workers had religious objections to the substance.
